title: AgentToolResult
description: Result of one tool call inside an embedded agent session. Read tools return bounded evidence references. Write tools return an ActionResult envelope from the shared executor; the session refuses any write whose envelope is missing or malformed.

read_payload.description: Bounded evidence references returned by a read tool. Counts and IDs only; no large blobs.

action_result_ref.description: Reference to the persisted ActionResult. Required when outcome is action_committed.

blocked_reason.description: Reason the executor rejected the call (when outcome is blocked).

error.description: Structured error for the failed outcome.
